items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: in fact I did a thing here with Stan Kenton, the neophonic thing

ctx.x: So that's one of the reasons -- in fact I did a thing here with Stan Kenton, the neophonic thing, and I wrote a big work for Wes. They had all the writers. I just had come out here to California, and I took a lot of time on this, and Stan has been trying to get that score ever since, but after Wes died I just got sentimental about it.
